node_notes.app: This application entry initializes the shared I2C bus and runs a startup address scan. Its calls and diagnostic logging are implemented in firmware/app/app.c through i2c_bus_init, i2c_bus_scan, and LOGI/LOGE.
node_notes.i2c: This is the I2C1 master bus used by the startup scan, with SCL on PB8 and SDA on PB9. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c configures those pins and performs the HAL I2C transactions; no specific attached device is established by the source.
node_notes.logger: This module formats tagged diagnostic records and sends them to the platform output. firmware/utils/logger/logger.c uses snprintf and vsnprintf before calling logger_platform_write.
node_notes.vcp: This is the real console sink for the firmware's diagnostic output, identified as the ST-LINK Virtual COM Port in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c. The platform UART adapter transmits the logger bytes through USART2.
node_notes.bridge: This adapter connects the portable logger to the STM32 UART adapter. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c initializes UART2 as needed and forwards each formatted record through platform_uart2_write.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries console logs over the NUCLEO-G070RB ST-LINK Virtual COM Port at the configured 115200 baud. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c assigns the UART alternate function to PA2 and PA3; its header documents the VCP signals.

lld.mermaid:

node_notes.init: The startup routine calls i2c_bus_init before attempting a scan. firmware/app/app.c checks the returned status so the scan is not started when initialization fails.
node_notes.scanok: This decision checks the scan status returned by i2c_bus_scan. firmware/app/app.c logs an error and returns on failure, or reports counts and ACK addresses on success.
node_notes.done: Finish startup diagnostic is a step in this firmware's runtime flow. The cite firmware/app/app.c:46-59 is the source evidence for it.
node_notes.scanfailure: When the scan status is not OK, the app logs the status and exits the scan-report routine. The error path is implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ack: The application iterates over the acknowledged address array and logs each address separately. The iteration and LOGI call are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.complete: For a successful sweep, the app logs the number of acknowledging addresses and the NACK probe count. It obtains the latter through i2c_bus_nack_probe_count_get in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.entry: Core/Src/main.c invokes app_start after the MCU setup. This transfers control into the firmware application startup diagnostic rather than treating the generated idle loop as application behavior.
node_notes.ready: On successful initialization, the application logs that I2C1 is ready on PB8/SCL and PB9/SDA and announces its address sweep. This diagnostic is emitted with LOGI in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.initfail: The initialization failure path emits a tagged error and exits the startup routine. The LOGE call is in firmware/app/app.c and the logger routes the record to the configured console.
node_notes.scan: The app_report_i2c_scan routine calls i2c_bus_scan to probe addresses from 0x08 through 0x77. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c holds its bus lock for the sweep and counts NACK probes.
node_notes.initok: This branch tests whether I2C initialization returned I2C_BUS_STATUS_OK. firmware/app/app.c logs the failure and returns on the negative path, while success proceeds to the readiness message and scan.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as Core main
  participant App as app_start
  participant I2C as I2C1 bus
  participant Log as logger formatter
  participant Bridge as UART logging bridge
  participant UART as USART2
  participant VCP as ST-LINK Virtual COM Port

  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>I2C: i2c_bus_init
  alt I2C initialization fails
    App->>Log: LOGE initialization failure
    Log->>Bridge: logger_platform_write formatted record
    Bridge->>UART: initialize USART2 and transmit
    UART->>VCP: diagnostic bytes
  else I2C initialization succeeds
    App->>Log: LOGI bus ready and scan intent
    Log->>Bridge: logger_platform_write formatted record
    Bridge->>UART: initialize USART2 and transmit
    UART->>VCP: diagnostic bytes
    App->>I2C: i2c_bus_scan addresses 0x08 through 0x77
    alt Scan reports an error
      App->>Log: LOGE scan failure
      Log->>Bridge: logger_platform_write formatted record
      Bridge->>UART: transmit diagnostic
      UART->>VCP: diagnostic bytes
    else Scan completes
      I2C-->>App: ACK addresses and NACK probe count
      App->>Log: LOGI ACK and NACK totals
      Log->>Bridge: logger_platform_write formatted record
      Bridge->>UART: transmit diagnostic
      UART->>VCP: diagnostic bytes
      loop For each acknowledged address
        App->>Log: LOGI acknowledged address
        Log->>Bridge: logger_platform_write formatted record
        Bridge->>UART: transmit diagnostic
        UART->>VCP: diagnostic bytes
      end
    end
  end
